title: Switzerland proposes banning profiling-based ads to minors
summary: Switzerland has proposed new legislation to ban profiling-based advertising targeting minors, aiming to protect children and teenagers from data-driven marketing practices that analyze their behavior and characteristics.
problem_solved: Addresses the privacy and developmental risks associated with targeted advertising that profiles minors' online behavior and personal data.
why_valuable: This policy provides legal protection for minors against invasive profiling practices in digital advertising, setting a precedent for stronger child privacy protections online.
